A `<svelte:boundary>` hydrated in the failed state can never be reset

### Describe the bug

A boundary that fails during SSR renders its `failed` snippet and hydrates back into the failed state from the serialized marker. During that hydration `onerror` is never called, and the `reset` handed to the `failed` snippet is a no-op ([boundary.js#L200-L210](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/blob/4a6a85b5f149cc96514ed3bf5e59083b9246d394/packages/svelte/src/internal/client/dom/blocks/boundary.js#L200-L210)). Once a boundary hydrates as failed there is no way to leave that state short of destroying the component, even when its children would render fine on the client.

[Bug]: DeprecationWarning: fs.F_OK is deprecated, use fs.constants.F_OK instead (DEP0176)

### 🔎 Search Terms

fs.F_OK

### The problem

Running winston on Node ≥ 22 emits:

(node:55907) [DEP0176] DeprecationWarning: fs.F_OK is deprecated, use fs.constants.F_OK instead

The warning comes from FileTransport._tail, which still reads F_OK directly off the fs module.

Node 22 deprecated fs.F_OK / fs.R_OK / fs.W_OK / fs.X_OK as direct properties on fs — see DEP0176. Replacement is fs.constants.F_OK.

Happy to send a PR if it helps.

### What version of Winston presents the issue?

v3.13.0

### What version of Node are you using?

v24.8.0
